title: Drain the lower phase from a separatory funnel
instruction: Recover the lower water phase into the receiver without oil carryover. Remove the top stopper, operate and close the stopcock at the interface, and leave the stopper in its clean dish and the apparatus released.
context: Common wet-lab research procedure following liquid-liquid extraction: recover the dense lower phase selectively while retaining the upper phase. Upper-air admission and actual stopcock operation couple to the moving phase interface. Safe water and edible oil model fluids only; no workforce-count claim.
